# Title Page

**Title:** Projected Clinical-Practice Departure and Fellowship Replacement in Gynecologic Surgical Specialty and Focused-Practice Workforces, 2025-2029

**Running head:** Gynecologic Subspecialist Workforce

**Précis:** In both gynecologic surgical subspecialties and an exploratory focused-practice cohort, annual fellowship graduate output exceeds administratively identified departures in headcount through 2029.
